properties.statement: A `verified` CAPABILITY WHOSE CENTRAL CLAIM IS FALSE IN THE INSTALLED DEFAULT DEPLOYMENT: SEAT LIVENESS IS THE SHARED SERVER'S PID, SO `gone` IS UNREACHABLE AND EVERY CLAIM OUTLIVES THE SESSION THAT MADE IT. `cap:claim-liveness` is status `verified` and its description states that claim_report 'COMPUTES liveness by asking the operating system whether that process still exists' and that 'a claim whose session exited is reported `gone`'. Measured by w-613d836b in dev_storyflow 2026-08-07: mint_seat returned `ajs77:2304014:4265e97f`; pid 2304014 is the `reflow2-mcp --serve-shared` daemon, while their own session's shell was 2315377 — different processes entirely. CONFIRMED IN THIS REPO: crates/reflow2-core/src/identity.rs:388 mints the seat as `format!("{}:{}:{mint}", machine(), std::process::id())`, and under `--shared` that code runs IN THE DAEMON, so the pid recorded is the server's for every seat it ever mints. The daemon is detached and outlives every client by design. THEREFORE the liveness probe asks whether the server is running — which it is, or nothing could have answered — and the answer is `live` for every claim, forever. IT FAILS IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: (a) a worker that died hours ago still reads as holding its region, so a peer defers to nobody, which is precisely the advisory report starting to lie that the capability's own description says exclusion from overlaps exists to prevent; (b) after a `--stop-shared` bounce the replacement daemon has a new pid, so EVERY seat minted before it is orphaned at once and nothing surfaces that. WHY THE CHECK DID NOT CATCH IT: the property was true under the old one-process-per-session stdio transport, where the serving process WAS the session. `--shared` became the installed default and the world moved; the verification did not, and nothing recomputes a check when the deployment model changes underneath it. This is the same class as the served-version gap the same fleet hit the same day — a literal that stayed satisfied while the invariant it stood for broke. FIX SHAPE, from the reporter and consistent with the design: record the CLIENT's identity — the Contributor handle claim_region is already given — alongside the server pid and compute liveness from that; or at minimum have claim_report mark any seat whose pid differs from the currently-serving pid as `stale: server-restarted` rather than `live`. The `stale` array already exists in the response shape.
properties.value: {"reported":"2026-08-07 dev_storyflow, w-613d836b, by execution","confirmed_here":"crates/reflow2-core/src/identity.rs:388 mint_seat uses std::process::id(), which under --shared is the daemon","node_status_at_time_of_report":"cap:claim-liveness = verified","evidence":"seat ajs77:2304014:4265e97f; 2304014 = reflow2-mcp --serve-shared; reporter session shell = 2315377","gone_state":"unreachable for shared-server seats","second_failure":"a --stop-shared bounce orphans every prior seat at once, silently","why_missed":"true under the old stdio one-process-per-session transport; --shared became the default and the check did not move","fix_shape":"compute liveness from the client Contributor handle, or flag seat pid != current serving pid as stale: server-restarted","not_yet_fixed":"true"}
